items.note: S2.1 states the lemma's content (copy/gather/scatter/side-injection gates, three stages, (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), scratch restored for arbitrary initial values) and quotes the three-stage composition at 763. It omits h=100, the triple indexing, the neighbour rule and the eight-row schedule, and does not derive the net change (JV+RG)x=x.

S2.2 has the mechanism (common frame commutes with a pointwise gate, so a route applies D_sink D_source^{-1}). It drops the route sign epsilon_w and never states the edge operator D_v D_u^{-1} or the global form D_out S D_in^{-1}.

Statement and sub-steps match Lemma lem:motif-residuals: comparable labels, only central 3->4 edges decrease (by h), budget Wm-2N+2L, and L/N<1/2. The derivation leaves out the essential ingredient: the bilinear forms under which neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal, which makes the side-wire labels nested (edge 2->5). It also omits the label table, L=Ich, the exact ratios 100/539 and 101/539, and the binary orthonormal bases.

S2.4 gives the endpoint identity I_m and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m. It assigns projections only 'to gates' and omits the negative source projection -P_{U_a} on X_a, which the paper calls essential to the endpoint identity (1472). It also omits the rank argument for P_V-P_U.

S2.5 has phase frames, one translation kernel per residual basis vector, C^{tensor m} on every role, and s_c<W_c m. It gives no formula for C_U, does not say the basis is orthonormal, gives no value for s_c (=W_c m-2N+2L_c), and omits the source/sink diagonal corrections and the undoing of the signed exchange needed before C^{tensor m} appears.
The plan states L/N<1/2, s_b<W_b m, s_c<W_c m, and tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} with s/W<m^tau. The deficits eta_b, eta_c and the argument eta>20*2^{-50} with log m<20 are absent.

S1.1 matches Lemma lem:elementary-streams. S1.2 omits the hypotheses of lem:ordered-affine-streams: the offset must be computable in b^{O(1)} time, q must be prime, and the rational denominators (and unit numerators) must be prime to q.

S3.2 correctly states the cost: exactly a interchanges plus O(V). S3.1 drops the invertibility of E_1, E_2, which the shear implementation needs. The elimination proof is only quoted, not reconstructed.

Follows the paper's proof step by step: cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} on edges by recursive pivot interchanges, the frame identity giving H<-H+D on every role, the three shears, s calls, the recurrence, the geometric sum, and the fixed-tape parking schedule.

Rows come from the top rho digits, rows are padded to a multiple of W^k, the width is split in base m, and the pieces sum to O(Ve^tau), all as in the paper. The plan omits the step that pads binary chunk ranges [2^u] to [q^e] (1721-1734), which turns O(Ve^tau) into O(Vu^tau) for bit arrays.

S4.1 (s_c child calls on f=e/m bits per slot) and S4.2 (H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D) are correct. The plan never states the conjugation by P_M that moves residual directions to coordinate slots, nor how inverse kernels become forward children ((C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z). It only alludes to 'packed binary basis changes'.

Gives the eight parity-controlled shifts, the bad set B with |B|<=delta_bad M, and the radix-sort repair, as in the paper. It does not say that each rotation first moves its target chunk into place with chunk swaps (Lemma lem:chunk-swap), which is the source of the L^tau term. It also omits why T_0 S_0^{-1} permutes B, and gives no formula for delta_bad.

The recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) and the geometric O(e^lambda) sum are stated. Missing are where the rows come from (the first q_0 chunks as row index), the leaf cutoff e<d^beta with the leaf bound O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), and the condition lambda'>max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}.

Follows the proof's route: phase frames, packed basis changes, recurrence, guard widths Delta=o(p), one final truncation with error <sqrt2 2^{-p}. It omits the row split that gives each child 1/W of the volume and supplies scratch roles from existing rows (2306-2333), which the s/W factor depends on.

The layout and cost derivation (prefix moves O(TpdK), Dq-1 chunk exchanges O(Tp pK^{tau-1}), ell layer rounds) follows 2990-3104. Character cancellation F^+F^-=t^{-1}I, the exact counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, and the error <sqrt2 ell 2^{-p} are not stated.
Gives evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, products by the established multiplier, centred residues, and O(rp log(rp)). Reduction mod y^r+1 and the output Q_p(fg/r) are left implicit.

Statement (M_r=(f*g)/(rM), error sqrt2 M(3ell+1)2^{-p}, cost) and route (retain the common LB order, pointwise products commute with the shared permutation, opposite transform, exact scale by M, error M(3delta+eta)) match the paper.

P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA and the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2 are stated. The hypotheses gcd(s,t)=1 in 1-D and theta=t/s-1>p/alpha^4, and the definitions of P_s, P_t, are missing. The one-dimensional proof (3576-3792) is only named in the method, not reconstructed.

Both identities are stated correctly, and S6.3 gives the reason (RF^+R=F^+, and permutations commute with pointwise products). The chirp a_j=exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i) is never defined, and the conjugation giving RF^+ is not mentioned.

b, p=6b, d, t_i in {r/2,r}, primes just below t_i and T/2<S<T are stated. K, the T range, alpha, gamma, eta, the prime interval and most of the fixed exponents (lambda, lambda', c, epsilon, delta) are not given.
The isomorphism x->prod x_i^{mu_i} and the triangular controlled-shift implementation are stated. mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i and the triangular digit formula are not given.
Gives x_d->zeta y with zeta=e^{pi i/r}, which turns cyclic wrap into negacyclic wrap, as in the paper.

Source transform F=2^gamma B_0QF_tA=RF_s and the two scalings giving 2^{2b+4}(u*v) follow the paper. S7 says the second rescale is by 2^{2b+4} where the paper uses 2^{2b+4}S, and it puts rounding after Phi^{-1}; the paper rounds first.

E_s=9*2^gamma TL, E_w=S(3E_s+2)<28*2^gamma T^2L, the final 448b 2^{-b+gamma}<=448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding and carries all match the paper. The ring and chirp sub-bounds (5TL, 8TL) and gamma<=b/4 are left implicit.

Table of normalized costs, minimum margin eps c(1-tau)=2^{-181}=2kappa from the chunk exchanges, log factors absorbed by p^kappa, and O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}), as in the paper. S9.1 names the rows without listing their powers.
S0 says the bound refutes the n log n conjecture in this model. The eventual lower bound and the liminf formulation are not stated.

errors.says: Assigning the projections P_U to gates gives rational matrices M_v whose endpoint differences are the identity I_m.
errors.paper: Gates and sinks get P_U, but the source of X_a gets -P_{U_a} and the other sources get zero. The negative source projection is what makes P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m, and the paper calls it essential to the endpoint identity; it is also why the source edge has rank one.

errors.says: a route applies only the endpoint operator D_sink D_source^{-1}.
errors.paper: A route applies epsilon_w D_{sink(rho(w))} D_{source(w)}^{-1}, including the scalar sign of the signed role permutation; the sign matters in the complex construction.

errors.says: E_1,E_2 lower triangular and Pi a partial permutation with exactly a ones.
errors.paper: E_1,E_2 are invertible lower triangular rational matrices; invertibility is needed for the shear implementation.

errors.says: Updating y->y+a(controls) mod q^b and multiplying by a fixed rational unit mod q^b cost O(V).
errors.paper: Only for prime q with denominators (and unit numerators) prime to q, and when the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time.

errors.says: the whole complex network realizes C^{tensor m} on every role.
errors.paper: Only after source and sink diagonal corrections (Z_{a,k}, i^{27k}) and undoing the signed bank exchange; uncorrected, the X_a->Y_a route has C^{-1} on 27 coordinates.

errors.says: rescaling by S and 2^{2b+4}, undoing the address map, rounding and carrying.
errors.paper: The second scale is by 2^{2b+4}S, and the coefficients are rounded before Phi^{-1} is applied.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}): rank-saving networks (S2), the interchange recursion (S3), the simultaneous layer (S4), synthetic convolution (S5), resampling, chirp and permutation cancellation (S6), assembly (S7), exact recovery (S8) and cost accounting (S9). It is thinnest at the label construction: the bilinear forms and the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines, which make the labels nested, are missing, and so is the negative source projection behind the endpoint identity. It is also thin in the layer recursion, where the row supply and V/W split are not described, and in the Gaussian resampling, which is only cited.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch wires and the gate types are present. h=100, the indexing of the data pairs by triples, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are all absent, so the network itself is not pinned down.

Common invertible frames commute with pointwise gates, so a route applies D_sink D_source^{-1}. The sign epsilon_w and the explicit edge operator D_vD_u^{-1} are missing, but the mechanism and its role (endpoints fix the operator, edges are frame changes) are there.

Nondegenerate subspaces of an m-dimensional space built from triple indicators; every edge joins comparable labels; only the central 3->4 edges decrease, each by h. The tensor space F^{tensor 3} and the bilinear forms are not named.

The plan says an edge costs its residual dimension and that N extra ranks are charged for sources. It never states that P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U, nor that each X_a source edge is 2P_{U_a} of rank one, so the rank-equals-dimension mechanism is only alluded to.
Sum of absolute changes = Wm-2N+2L and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b are both stated. L=Ich is not written but follows from S2.3.2 (only central edges, loss h).
L/N<1/2 in both constructions, the deficit N-2L_b>0 (quoted at 1167) and s_b<W_b m are stated. The exact ratios 100/539 and 101/539 are omitted.
Endpoint differences are I_m, so every role, scratch included, receives H<-H+D. The source matrix -P_{U_a} that produces the identity is not mentioned.
Rank-a matrix factors as E_1 Pi E_2, the shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), each edge recursively interchanges its pivot pairs, and a node makes exactly s calls.
Children have volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), tau=1-2^{-50} with s/W<m^tau, and F_k=O(e^tau). The justification of tau (eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20) is not given.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the second half of the chain well: endpoint identity, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) giving e^tau. It also has the budget Wm-2N+2L and the strict saving L<N/2. It is weak at the start: the concrete network (h=100, triples, N, m) is not given, and the link from label dimension change to matrix rank (projection differences and the rank-one source edges) is only alluded to. 7 of 9 steps are reconstructed.
